interpretation: Rows are different frozen development candidates, not repetitions of one latest frozen release. T1 a010 plus its read-only rationale supplement is the sole currently deliverable task evidence (1/7); this does not establish formal acceptance.
The 26-row totals exclude historical five-batch baseline and developer probes p001/p002. The linked cumulative campaign ledger includes those; do not sum the two totals.
Known tokens contain only confirmed usage; a002 and a027 retain unknown occupied token reservations. a004 also retains two unknown-start upper bounds from the separate hash-bound reconciliation.
Wall seconds are original driver elapsed time, not measured ORCA CPU or complete process-tree resource cost.
A failed/partial or paused Run may contain real completed science; a completed Tool or satisfied Goal alone is not independent scientific acceptance.
a027 HTTP 402 is a model-service balance failure, not a scientific failure. No restart, resume, extra model request or cost reset is authorized by this matrix.
